title: formal-mathfin: A Formally Verified Library of Mathematical Finance in Lean 4
description: A Lean 4 library of machine-checked mathematical-finance theorems: 754 sorry-free theorems, 739 of them delivery-ready, depending only on the axioms propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. It covers continuous-time stochastic calculus (the Ito integral, Ito's formula, quadratic variation, Levy's characterization, Girsanov's theorem and martingale representation), Black-Scholes pricing with the Greeks and exotics, jump-diffusion models (Merton's formula, Esscher pricing and variance swaps), binomial trees including the CRR-to-Black-Scholes limit, replication and American options, a contract language that prices the same payoffs in Black-Scholes and the binomial tree, the geometry of the American put exercise boundary, a polynomial-sign characterisation of raw SVI smiles whose call price is convex in the strike, fixed income (bond prices in the Vasicek, Hull-White and GSR models, Jamshidian's bond options, caps, swaptions and CMS under the annuity measure, credit default swaps, inflation, CVA and the Nelson-Siegel-Svensson curve), commodities, portfolio theory, coherent risk measures, quantitative risk management (value at risk for every loss law, expected shortfall for every integrable loss, copulas, extreme-value distributions and credit-portfolio models), actuarial mathematics, market microstructure and DeFi. Built on Mathlib and Remy Degenne's BrownianMotion package. Every result is classified by how faithfully its Lean statement matches the mathematical claim, and a build-enforced axiom audit pins the axioms each proof depends on.
